description: Use this when the user wants to study a creator's or brand's recent posts in depth (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube or Facebook): it adds them to a canvas as a group and transcribes and analyses each. About 1-15 credits plus transcription. Returns a `job_id` while the profile is read. Do not use just to rank posts (use xcut_find_outliers).

canvas_id.description: Optional. Leave it out unless the user names a canvas: XcutAI then uses their "From AI apps" canvas. Ids come from xcut_list_canvases.
canvas_id.title: Canvas Id

name: xcut_import_profile
title: Import a profile's recent posts
